summary.en: Container packaging of PostgreSQL with example.org's runtime conventions

description.en:
Two contributions in one repository:

1. The example.org container runtime — entrypoint hooks, healthcheck
   protocol, structured logs. Original work, authored here.

2. Container packaging of upstream PostgreSQL, configured to follow
   example.org conventions (multi-arch, locale build, secret layout).

The MIT license declared in this repository covers only the additions
above. Upstream PostgreSQL and every package installed into the image
retain their own licenses; see LICENSES/ for the inventory.
